entries.source: You have %d class talent point(s) to spend. Press p to use them.
entries.target: 你有 %d 职业技能点数，按下p来使用。

entries.source: Large and hairy with flesh-rending claws. It smells slightly of fish.
entries.target: 体型巨大、浑身长毛，还有能撕裂血肉的利爪。它闻起来略带鱼腥味。

entries.source: Increases the effectiveness of all healing the target receives by %d%%.
entries.target: 提升目标受到的所有治疗效果 %d%%。

entries.source: Beautiful and nearly impregnable. Separating it from the dragon must have been hard work.
entries.target: 美丽且异常坚固的龙鳞。把它从龙身上扒下来一定费了不少力气。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#25%%#LAST# chance for lightning to strike from the target to a second target dealing #VIOLET#%d#LAST# damage
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#25%%#LAST#几率造成连锁闪电，从这个目标跳跃到另一个目标，造成#VIOLET#%d#LAST#伤害
并被喂给了幼龙们分食

entries.source: A vial of greater demon bile. It hurts your sinuses even with the vial's stopper firmly in place.
entries.target: 一瓶大恶魔的胆汁。尽管有着良好的阻隔，它仍刺激着你的鼻窦。

entries.source: You cannot use Death Dance without a two-handed weapon!
entries.target: 你需要装备一把双手武器来施展这个技能。

entries.source: A small but sharp axe, with a handle made of polished bone.  The blade has chopped through the skulls of many, and has been stained a deep crimson.
entries.target: 一把小巧而锋利的斧头，斧柄由打磨过的骨头制成。这把斧头打破了许多头骨，并被染成了鲜红色。

entries.source: You are yanked out of this place!
entries.target: 你“呼”的一下被带离了这个地方！

entries.source: You need to ready alchemist gems in your quiver.
entries.target: 你需要在箭袋中装填炼金宝石。

entries.source:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
entries.target:
里奇是原产于远东南部干旱地区的一种巨型土著昆虫。
他们是凶残的猎食者，用锋利的爪子刺穿大部分的盔甲，将腐败的疾病注入敌人的体内。

entries.source: Unlike the rest of the black mamba, the severed head isn't moving.
entries.target: 不像黑曼巴的其余部分，这颗被斩下的头一动不动。

entries.source: A very faded note, nearly unreadable.
entries.target: 极度磨损的笔记，几乎无法阅读。

entries.source: Just give me the basics (reveals locked talent category) - 100 gold.
entries.target: 只学习基础（揭示锁定的技能树）- 100 金币。

entries.source: A ritch stinger, still glistening with venom.
entries.target: 一只里奇的螫针，还残留着许多粘稠的毒液。

entries.source: Improves senses, allowing the detection of unseen things.
entries.target: 强化感知，可以看到看不到的东西

entries.source: A messily scrawled pile of loose papers.
entries.target: 一堆乱涂乱画的散乱文件。

entries.source: You require a weapon and a shield to use this talent.
entries.target: 你需要一把武器一个盾牌来施展这个技能。

entries.source: %s appears out of the thin air!
